name: Barbarian: Carnage grants Born in Blood on a killing blow (#9402)
contract: Carnage (803814) tooltip: killing an enemy that yields experience or honor grants Born in Blood (560521). Its own effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 560521, but Spell.dbc gives 803814 ProcFlags 0, and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped generating a proc entry entirely and the aura effect could never fire. A spell_proc row with ProcFlags PROC_FLAG_KILL (2) is required, the same gap the Barbarian-completion pass already closed for the sibling passive Thick Skull (801549), which already has a working row and is not touched here.

steps.label: Born in Blood absent before the kill
DISCRIMINATING (#9402): killing blow grants Born in Blood from Carnage
